root_causes.title_en: Network link problem in your area
root_causes.title_ar: مشكلة في وصلة الشبكة في منطقتك
root_causes.customer_text_en: A network link that serves your area has a problem. A technician has been assigned.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: فيه مشكلة في وصلة شبكة بتخدم منطقتك، واتحدد فني يصلحها.

root_causes.customer_text_en: The tower serving your area isn't working at full strength. Our engineers are on it.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: البرج اللي بيخدم منطقتك مش شغال بكفاءته الكاملة، ومهندسينا متابعين.

root_causes.customer_text_en: The tower serving your area has a fault. Our engineers are working on it.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: البرج اللي بيخدم منطقتك فيه عطل، ومهندسينا شغالين عليه.

root_causes.customer_text_en: The network in your area is very busy right now, which slows things down. Our team is adding capacity.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: الشبكة في منطقتك عليها ضغط عالي دلوقتي فالسرعة بتقل. فريقنا بيزوّد السعة.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Part of our central network has a problem affecting several areas. Our engineers are fixing it.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: فيه جزء من الشبكة الرئيسية عنده مشكلة مأثرة على كذا منطقة، ومهندسينا بيصلحوها.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Roaming isn't switched on for your line, so data doesn't work abroad.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: خدمة التجوال مش مفعلة على خطك، علشان كده النت مش شغال بره مصر.

root_causes.title_en: Phone not connected to the network
root_causes.customer_text_en: Your phone isn't connected to our network right now. A few simple steps on the phone usually fix this.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: موبايلك مش متصل بالشبكة دلوقتي. خطوات بسيطة على الموبايل غالبًا بتحل المشكلة.

root_causes.customer_text_en: There's interference on the signal in your area. Our engineers are tracing it.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: فيه تداخل على الإشارة في منطقتك، ومهندسينا بيدوروا على مصدره.

root_causes.customer_text_en: There's a known outage in your area. We're fixing it and will let you know the expected time.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: فيه عطل معروف في منطقتك، وبنصلحه وهنبلغك بالوقت المتوقع.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Your line is suspended, so it can't use the network until the reason is cleared.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: خطك موقوف، فمش هيقدر يستخدم الشبكة لحد ما سبب الإيقاف يتحل.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Your balance has run out, so data and calls are paused until you recharge.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: رصيدك خلص، فالنت والمكالمات واقفين لحد ما تشحن.

root_causes.customer_text_en: The signal where you are is weak. We've passed your location to our network team.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: الإشارة في مكانك ضعيفة. بلّغنا فريق الشبكة بمكانك.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Your line's network settings don't match your plan. We can refresh them for you.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: إعدادات خطك على الشبكة مش مطابقة لباقتك. نقدر نحدّثها من عندنا.

root_causes.customer_text_en: You've used all the data in your bundle. You can renew it or add an extra bundle.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: إنت استهلكت كل ميجات الباقة. تقدر تجدد أو تضيف باقة إضافية.

root_causes.customer_text_en: Your data connection got stuck on our side. We can reset it for you from here.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: اتصال النت بتاعك علّق عندنا. نقدر نعمله إعادة تشغيل من عندنا.

root_causes.customer_text_en: We couldn't find the cause from here, so we're passing it to a specialist.
root_causes.customer_text_ar: ماقدرناش نحدد السبب من هنا، فهنحوّل الموضوع لمتخصص.

demo_faults.note: Mobile data stopped: Net 55 bundle fully used (3500 of 3500 MB).
Mobile data stuck: attached and has quota, but the data session has passed no traffic for 95 minutes.
Slow data on a 5G plan: the network still has the old 4G subscriber profile.
No service: the phone has not been attached to the network since 06:12 this morning; nothing wrong on the network side.
Calls drop at home: very weak signal at the customer's location, serving cell healthy.
No service: the serving cell has been down since 13:20 (open cell_down alarm); no outage declared yet.
Slow data and drops: the site's backhaul link is losing packets (open backhaul_degraded alarm); the cell itself is fine.
Data sessions fail to start: the regional SMF is degraded (open alarm), affecting the whole Red Sea and Sinai region.
No mobile data: inside a declared ongoing outage (OUT-D029, equipment fault on the Imbaba cell since 10:30).
Intermittent slowness with every check normal: should end as inconclusive and be handed to a specialist.
